title: Nell and Ollie's Warm Surprise
markdown:
Moonbeams fell through the little window. They made soft, silver paths on Nell the little cat's fluffy rug. It looked like a calm, moonlit meadow. Nell stretched. Her little grey body felt long and warm. Beside her, in his own little nest, Ollie the baby owl blinked his big, round eyes. "Hoo-hoo," he whispered. His sound was low and soft. The night was peaceful. It was like a quiet lullaby.

A little whisper of wind rustled the leaves outside. Nell's ears twitched. She listened to the soft night whispers. Ollie tilted his fluffy head. His amber eyes were wide. They looked towards the window seat. The gentle moonlight was there. On the soft cushion sat a little teddy bear. The pale moonlight made him look pale. Nell saw his stuffing quiver. It looked like he was feeling a tiny bit cool. Ollie gave a soft, questioning "Hoo?"

Nell padded softly across the floor. Her paws made no sound, like tiny whispers. She nudged Ollie gently with her soft nose. "Look, Ollie," she whispered. Her voice was soft, like falling snow. "The little teddy bear is resting so peacefully." Ollie peered closer. Yes, Nell was right. The teddy bear looked so peaceful. His little button eyes seemed to look calm.

Nell remembered the special button wrap. It was wonderfully soft and warm. It felt like captured moonlight. It was just the perfect size, she thought. "This wrap feels so soft and warm," Nell murmured. Her tail gave a little swish. "It would be nice to share its softness." Ollie nodded. "Hoo-hoo, yes! Sharing softness is lovely!"

Nell gently nudged the soft, warm button wrap with her nose. It felt wonderfully light and comforting. Ollie settled back into his nest. He watched the teddy bear on the window seat. The little teddy bear snuggled into the soft, welcoming warmth of the wrap. His button eyes seemed to look calm and happy now. He looked so safe and warm, all tucked in. Nell and Ollie watched. Nell gave a soft, contented purr. Ollie gave a happy little "Hoo-hoo."

Nell padded softly back to her fluffy rug. Ollie settled back into his nest. The moonlight still fell through the little window. It felt even softer, even warmer. Nell curled into a little grey ball. Her green eyes were getting heavy. Ollie tucked his fluffy head under his wing. His amber eyes closed slowly, softly. The little teddy bear on the window seat was all warm and snug. Everything was just right, perfectly peaceful and safe. And soon, Nell and Ollie, nestled in their own cozy beds, drifted off to sweet, sleepy dreams.
characters: Nell the night kitten, Ollie the owl chick
